proposed.label: Base left out of the total surface area
proposed.description: The student adds up only the four triangular faces and forgets the square base, so the answer is 2bh_s instead of b^2 + 2bh_s.

proposed.label: Triangle area without the one half
proposed.description: The student finds the area of each triangular face as base times slant height, leaving out the factor of one half, so the four faces come to 4bh_s instead of 2bh_s.

proposed.label: Leaves out the circular base
proposed.description: Gives only the area of the walls, pi*r*h, when asked for the total surface area, which also includes the area of the base circle.

proposed.label: Uses the cylinder's wall area for the cone
proposed.description: Writes the walls as 2*pi*r*h, the curved area of a cylinder, instead of pi*r*h for a cone.

proposed.label: Uses the vertical height for the walls
proposed.description: Puts the vertical height (apex straight down to the centre of the base) into pi*r*h instead of the slant height measured along the wall.
